metadata.root_publication_work: Fixed depth10 credential tree, four issuer slots; actual 8-leaf additions and occupied-slot replacements; not a population load test.
metadata.revocation_model: Trusted issuer update declaration; opaque root does not enforce addition-only semantics. Public-ID revoke alone is signed-status only; revokeAndPublish pairs representations.
metadata.failure_model: Included reverted transactions are measured separately; static preflight rejection incurs no chain gas. No observed network failure frequency is inferred.
metadata.cost_boundary: Local L1 execution; fixture token/setup separate; issuer/witness services, actual user latency and full L2 fees unmeasured.
metadata.proof_boundary: Single-thread fullProve plus separate strict verification; per-event server samples are not physical-device results.
